earlierR8ComparisonOnly: Existing portrait game shares the main official symbol/forest/logo/wheel composition, same white HOLD & SPIN button and flanking controls.

Existing right bet-control glyph is an outlined hexagon enclosing a currency mark; official demo/marketing shows a plain stylized dollar glyph inside the circular ring. A glyph-only frontend change can match it.

Existing lower balance/bet panels are translucent pale green with wide soft glows; official promotional still shows darker fill with tighter neon-green border. Exact color judgment from the Android screenshot is limited because sound consent darkens the whole background.
The official product naming is Foxy Hot20; existing route hot_foxy_20 can remain stable while visible spelling follows source. Do not alter backend model identity to follow naming.
